projectTitle: MMWEC: A member portal and a rebate application
project_haiku: Massachusetts municipal utilities needed a private place for reports and a public path for NextZero rebates. We built both on Drupal: a member portal with permissions by town, and the rebate application in front of it.
project_footer_CTA: Need a portal where each member sees only their own reports? MMWEC is that system, plus the rebate application their customers use.
pageSummary:
The job

MMWEC is the joint-action agency for Massachusetts municipal utilities. It serves member light departments with power supply, finance, and risk management, and it runs NextZero, the efficiency program those utilities offer their customers. Reports were moving by email. Rebates needed a real application, not a PDF on a page.

What we built

The member portal is Drupal. A utility user sees the reports, invoices, budgets, and notes their town is allowed to see. Staff file meeting notes, marketing, and newsletters under the same role rules. NextZero customers start rebate requests for audits, appliances, heat pumps, and the measures their utility has chosen to offer.

Outcomes

A member town opens the portal and finds its own documents. A customer starts a rebate without mailing a form. MMWEC staff control who sees which file.
